Pointers on cabin readiness
This article is for pet owners

Cabin readiness for companion travel

I am sorry to say that careful preparation is still the best way to keep an animal steady and calm during travel. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk asks travelers to review the cabin space before departure, because a quiet and secure setup helps both the animal and the route run smoothly.

Please place the carrier in the approved position and make sure it remains closed throughout boarding. The floor area should be clear of loose items, and the pet should have enough room to settle without being crowded. If you are traveling with a nervous animal, a familiar blanket may help reduce stress, provided it does not obstruct ventilation.

<<FACT F087>> Please keep all handling gentle and avoid sudden movements near the carrier, as our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals. If your pet needs water or a brief pause before boarding, ask a member of staff early so the process can be managed without delay.

Label the carrier plainly and keep travel papers within easy reach. <<FACT F095>> It is also wise to confirm that all required documents match the traveler and the pet, since small errors can slow the journey. If you are unsure whether your cabin setup is suitable, a quick review with our team can prevent avoidable trouble.

For more help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
